outcome: developmental abnormalities of the skin and oral mucosa
cohort: The study included all newborns up to 72 hours of age admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit of a tertiary referral hospital.
finding: At least one cutaneous manifestation was found in 92.5% of newborns, with transient benign cutaneous lesions being the most common, and these, along with developmental abnormalities, were significantly more common in newborns with normal birth weight.
birth_weight: Birth weight was recorded, with a specific finding relating to 'normal birth weight' babies.
gest_age: Gestational age was recorded for the newborns in the study.
